q1_issues.issue: The appositive "the brothers" yields a bare (Brother antonio_benavente jacinto_benavente) atom while every other categorical atom of this past-tense clause is Past-wrapped, contrary to the mechanical rule that an appositive takes the host clause's wrapper.

q2_gaps: coordinated proper names sharing an elided surname ("Antonio and Jacinto Benavente"): the name rule takes the capitalized run verbatim, which would give the name string "Antonio", not "Antonio Benavente"
a copular clause whose predicate is a PP ("were among her admirers"), and its locative-inversion word order — the two-kinds-of-clause split covers only "is a/an N" and "is ADJ"
notes: Each man's membership is stated twice — (Past (Member x admirer)) beside (Past (PartOf x sk_group_1)) over a group already typed (GroupOf sk_group_1 admirer) — which is redundant rather than wrong. Brother is read as licensed under the Symmetric open-class license even though it comes from an appositive noun rather than a copula.
